header.heading: Ways to Give
header.lede: Every gift, of any size, helps sustain our liturgies, care for our historic church, and serve our neighbors. Giving is handled securely by trusted platforms — the parish website never collects payment information.

zeffy.heading: Give Online with Zeffy
zeffy.text: One-time or recurring gifts by card or bank transfer. Zeffy is free for churches, so 100% of your gift reaches the parish.

venmo.heading: Give with Venmo
venmo.text: A quick way to give from your phone. Send to @SaintMaronPhilly or use the button below.
